name: ui/segmented-control
title: SegmentedControl
summary: A choice of one from a few, as a pill track of segments built on native radios in a fieldset: no script, arrow keys move between segments and screen readers announce a radio group.

divergences: Root: a <div role="radiogroup" aria-label> with a data-portal, not a <fieldset> with a <legend>.

Segments: <button role="radio" aria-checked> children (`SegmentedControlItem`, data-slot `segmented-control-item`) with a client script ("use client", useState, arrow-key handlers), not native radios built from `options`.
Sizes: sm/default/lg with a 40px/48px/56px track and 32px/40px/48px segments, not 40px/48px segments.

props.name: name
props.description: The radios' shared name, so the choice submits with a plain form.

props.name: legend
props.description: The group's accessible name, rendered as the fieldset's <legend>.

props.name: options
props.description: `[value, label]` pairs, one segment each, in order.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Keep the legend for screen readers only (sr-only).

behaviour: Renders a <fieldset> with a <legend> and a pill track holding one <label> per option.
Each label wraps a visually hidden native radio (peer sr-only) and the visible segment <span>; the radio matching `value` is checked.
The checked segment is styled through `peer-checked:` (card background, shadow) and the focused one through `peer-focus-visible:` (ring), so it needs no script.
The track wraps onto more lines when the segments do not fit.

hidden-legend.description: The legend kept for screen readers only.

keyboard: Native radios: Tab enters the group at the checked segment; arrow keys move and check.
focus: The focused segment shows a 2px `--ring` ring, offset from `--background`.
aria: The fieldset's <legend> names the group, also when hidden (sr-only).
Each segment's label text names its radio.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: the checked segment is `--card` on `--muted` in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: native radios check, move with the arrow keys and submit with the form.

responsive: The track is inline and at most its container's width; segments wrap onto further lines when they do not fit, from 320px.
contract:
contract
  slot is "segmented-control"
  span "List" min_height 40
  when default shows legend "View"
  when hidden-legend shows legend "View"
  when small slot is "segmented-control"
end

checks.say: One native radio per option, sharing the name.
The radio matching value is checked.
The radio matching value is checked (grid).
One segment per option, each in a label with its radio.
The legend is visible by default.
hideLegend keeps the legend for screen readers only.

gaps: The `sm` size is 40px on every pointer: on touch it is under the 44px target (WCAG 2.5.8 is met; 2.5.5 is not).
No disabled segments, and no way to mark the group required.
